newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low offer in S.Lanka diesel, jet tender from Shell.
newsitem.headline: Low offer in S.Lanka diesel, jet tender from Shell.

text.p: The lowest offer in Sri Lanka's tender to buy gas oil and jet fuel for July 12-13 delivery was made by Shell, an official with state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) said on Wednesday.

The offer for 250,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil was at a discount of 13.5 cents per barrel to Singapore spot quotes and for 50,000 barrels of jet fuel at 18.5 cents per barrel discount to Singapore spot quotes, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Colombo.
The tender, which attracted six offers, closed on June 18 and would be awarded later this evening.
The official said CPC would decide on June 24 to issue another tender to buy gas oil and jet fuel which could be for July 30-31 delivery.

In its previous tender for June 27-28 delivery, CPC bought from Dutch trader Vitol 250,000 barrels of gas oil at an 11.5-cent discount to Singapore spot quotes, and 50,000 barrels of jet fuel at a 6.5-cent discount, c-and-f Colombo.
